notFound.notes: The member is real and verifiable: an Enjin user "Pariah" (profile id 894814) posted on the 2012 Midnight Mercs forum (midnightmercs.enjin.com, archived on Wayback July 2012; seen as poster in threads such as "For Warhammer 40000 fans only please" and "ArmA Armed Assault"). The Midnight Mercs Steam group (MidnightMercss) confirms the community lineage with its announcement "Our website is now www.2ndCS.com". However, no YouTube channel could be tied to this person. The direct handle youtube.com/@Pariah (UC28JUgZpf7h5FU85peg8PKQ) is a classical music channel (Beethoven/Wagner/Mahler with Chinese subtitles) with zero community content. A YouTube channel-filter search for "pariah" surfaced roughly 20 candidate channels (@Pariah-l4u, @PariahGaming, @pariahclan, @Pariah6950, @findthepariah, @PariahDaOne, @PariahWasOne, @Pariahss1, @pariah3167, @MortisPariah, @PariahDisciple, Pariah Productions, etc.); each was inspected and none contains Warband/Napoleonic Wars/2ndCS/Coldstream/linebattle/21stPA/Battlegrounds content. @Pariah-l4u (UCpo61eB6OImPFnfdOL8KxTA), which YouTube surfaces for "pariah coldstream warband", has only 45 videos, all CK3/RimWorld/Valheim from recent years, and its uploads playlist contains no community keywords. Enumerating the owners of 2ndCS/2nd Coldstream linebattle videos across multiple searches (2ndColdstreamGuards, Zelkova Koti Moon, Skzjr, dewad, williambinette, ironhide650, CrazyKillerGaming1, DeltaRanger7474, MOVIE_1000, cosmic_bean, HxC4Lyfe08, Gijs Walravens) shows no Pariah-named uploader.
